title: 第3章 非常女主

content_zh:
这话说得漂亮，听着舒服，李惠娘和梁心铭都感谢她，然后惠娘拉着梁心铭走了，张奶奶来到豆腐摊子前。
她还意犹未尽，还想延续刚才的话题，因对司马姑娘说道：“这秀才两口子，都是好人呐！”
“好人”这个词，很不够形容她要表达的丰富内涵，可是她又想不出更贴切的词语，只能将就着用。
司马姑娘强笑着，用竹铲铲了一块豆腐给张奶奶，心里羞愤气苦：梁嫂子做什么防她跟防狼一样？是，她是偷偷喜欢梁秀才，看见他就心跳脸红，可她又没对他怎么样！
豆腐西施委屈极了，觉得自己白担了怀疑。
若梁秀才真和她有点什么，这怀疑也算值了，可是他们之间什么都没有，他甚至都没仔细瞧过她。
人人都说梁秀才能中举人、将来中进士，司马姑娘却并不是因为这个喜欢他的，也不是因为他长得俊。
她喜欢他，另有缘故。
那天傍晚，她卖完豆腐收摊，走在竹竿巷内，经过梁家租住的小院门口，见那院门没关严，她无意中往里扫了一眼。透过门缝，她看见梁心铭抱着小朝云坐在院子当中，面前放着小方桌，正握着她的小手教她写字。
一个字写完，小朝云把脑袋后仰，亲了爹爹下巴一下。
梁心铭微笑低头，也亲了女儿腮颊一下。
父女脸贴脸，接着又写。
那男子脸上透着温柔、耐心，一下子打动了司马姑娘。她红着眼睛想，嫁给他怕是不行了——李惠娘把夫君看得很牢，不可能容他纳妾，要是能做他女儿多好。
司马姑娘贪恋梁心铭的温柔，又求而不得，每日都很煎熬。
她很不忿自己的命运：做不成梁心铭的媳妇，也做不成他女儿，求一份安稳日子总不算过分吧？
还真是难！
她家有病弱的寡母，还有一个小妹妹，生活的重担全压在她肩上。每天早上，她都要推着豆腐车走街串巷地叫卖，卖完一批，再回来家门口摆摊卖第二批。有天早晨，她正在街上卖豆腐，被城里有名的“毒老虎”给盯上了。
“毒老虎”姓杜，是徽州城恶霸。
他几次调戏司马姑娘，放话要娶她。
想起他，司马姑娘愁容满面。

再说梁心铭一家。
经历之前买东西一幕，一家人越发亲爱，半点没有备战秋闱的紧张，只有温馨。惠娘进院就忙乎起来，一面奔向厨房，一面叫朝云：“快下来，别老缠着你爹。他写了三天的字，手上都没劲了呢，哪搁得住你这么歪缠。”
朝云不用娘叫，自己急忙就从爹爹身上下来了，迈着小短腿跑进厨房，找她娘拿碗，说要跟爹爹分饼吃。
李惠娘递给她一个碗，叮嘱道：“拿稳些，别打碎了。”
小朝云忙紧紧地把碗抱在怀里，放慢脚步走去堂屋。
梁心铭拗不过女儿贴心，最终还是和她分吃这个饼。
他抱着朝云坐在桌边，面前摆着碗，把饼掰成两半，递一半给朝云，又将碗端起来，接在她胸前。
朝云没吃，先侧首仰面看着他咬了一口，忙问：“爹爹香不香？”他点头道：“爹爹香。”
朝云丝毫没感到他的语病，乐得眼睛弯成月牙儿，捏着半块饼也咬了一小口，小嘴嚼得特别欢，嚼了半天也舍不得吞下去，仿佛在回味，怕吞下去那味道就没了。
梁心铭定定地看着女儿，目光温润如水，道：“等放榜了，爹爹买几斤回来，让云儿吃个够。”
小朝云大声应道：“好好！”
她对爹爹的话从来不怀疑。
在她幼小的心里，爹爹可能耐了，说什么是什么，说放榜那天买几斤饼，那就一定会买回来。至于为什么要等到放榜那天才能买，就不是她该操心的事了。
李惠娘飞快地炒了一碗青菜一碗秋扁豆，又从灶洞里将煨罐小心搬出来，将炖好的鸡汤舀了一大瓦钵，将煨罐依旧放回灶洞内，然后将几个菜都端去堂间，摆在四方桌上。
小朝云立即被鸡汤的香气吸引了。
这香气实在刺激得她抗拒不了，想要把目光从瓦钵上挪开，那是千难万难，比不看烧饼难多了！
李惠娘首先帮梁心铭盛了一大碗鸡汤，还把鸡肝以及鸡肚内没见天的蛋黄都舀给他，鸡腿也搛了一只给他；剩下一只鸡腿则盛给了小朝云；她自己，啃鸡骨头和鸡脚。

content_en:
This was beautifully said and comfortable to listen to. Both Li Huiniang and Liang Xinming thanked her. Then Huiniang took Liang Xinming away, and Grandma Zhang came to the tofu stall.
She still wanted to continue the topic, so she said to Miss Sima: "These talented couple are both good people!"
The word "good person" was not enough to describe the rich connotation she wanted to express, but she couldn't think of a more appropriate word, so she had to make do with it.
Miss Sima forced a smile and shoveled a piece of tofu to Grandma Zhang with a bamboo shovel. She felt ashamed, angry and bitter: What did Sister-in-law Liang do to guard against her, just like guarding against wolves? Yes, she secretly likes Liang Xiucai, her heart beats and she blushes when she sees him, but she doesn't do anything to him!
Tofu Xishi felt extremely aggrieved and felt that she had been doubted in vain.
If Liang Xiucai really had something to do with her, the suspicion would be considered worthwhile, but there was nothing between them, and he didn't even look at her carefully.
Everyone said that Liang Xiu was able to win the imperial examination and become a Jinshi in the future, but Miss Sima didn't like him because of this, nor because of his good looks.
She likes him for another reason.
That evening, after she finished selling tofu and closed the stall, she was walking in Zhugan Alley and passed the door of the small courtyard where the Liang family rented. Seeing that the door of the courtyard was not closed tightly, she accidentally glanced inside. Through the crack in the door, she saw Liang Xinming sitting in the yard with Xiao Chaoyun in his arms, with a small square table in front of him, holding her little hand and teaching her to write.
After writing a word, Xiao Chaoyun tilted his head back and kissed his father's chin.
Liang Xinming smiled, lowered his head, and kissed his daughter on the cheek.
Father and daughter cheek to cheek, then write again.
The man's face showed gentleness and patience, which immediately impressed Miss Sima. She thought with red eyes that she might not be able to marry him - Li Huiniang regarded her husband very closely and could not allow him to take a concubine. It would be great if she could be his daughter.
Miss Sima was greedy for Liang Xinming's tenderness, but she couldn't get it. She was suffering every day.
She was very unhappy with her fate: she couldn't be Liang Xinming's wife or his daughter, so it wasn't too much to ask for a stable life, right?
It’s really difficult!
She has a sick widowed mother and a little sister at home, and the burden of life falls entirely on her shoulders. Every morning, she would push the tofu cart through the streets and sell it. After selling one batch, she would come back and set up a stall in front of her house to sell the second batch. One morning, while she was selling tofu on the street, she was targeted by the famous "Poisonous Tiger" in the city.
"Poisonous Tiger" whose surname is Du is a bully in Huizhou City.
He teased Miss Sima several times and threatened to marry her.
Thinking of him, Miss Sima looked sad.
Let’s talk about Liang Xinming’s family.
After experiencing the previous shopping scene, the family became more and more affectionate. There was no tension in preparing for autumn, only warmth. Hui Niang got busy as soon as she entered the hospital. As she ran to the kitchen, she called Chaoyun: "Come down quickly and stop pestering your father. He has been writing for three days and his hands are exhausted. How can he tolerate you being so stubborn."
Chaoyun didn't need her mother to call her, she quickly got off her father's body, ran into the kitchen with her short legs, asked her mother to get a bowl, and said she wanted to share the cake with her father.
Li Huiniang handed her a bowl and warned, "Hold it carefully and don't break it."
Xiao Chaoyun hugged the bowl tightly in his arms and walked slowly to the main room.
Liang Xinming couldn't resist her daughter's thoughtfulness, and finally shared the cake with her.
He hugged Chao Yun and sat at the table with a bowl in front of him. He broke the cake in half, handed half to Chao Yun, then picked up the bowl and placed it on her chest.
Chao Yun didn't eat. He looked up at him first and took a bite. He quickly asked, "Does it smell good?" He nodded and said, "It smells good, dad."
Chaoyun didn't feel his speech problem at all, his eyes were so happy that they turned into crescents. He held half a piece of cake and took a small bite. His little mouth chewed very happily. After chewing for a long time, he couldn't bear to swallow it, as if he was aftertasteing it, fearing that the taste would be gone if he swallowed it.
Liang Xinming looked at her daughter steadily, her eyes as warm as water, and said: "When the results are released, daddy will buy a few kilograms and let Yun'er eat as much as she can.. "
Xiao Chaoyun responded loudly: "Okay! "
She never doubted her father's words.
In her young mind, her father might have been impatient and told her what it was and how many kilograms of cakes she would buy on the day when the results were released, so she would definitely buy them back. As for why she had to wait until the day the list was released to buy it, that was not something she should worry about.
Li Huiniang quickly stir-fried a bowl of green vegetables and a bowl of autumn lentils, then carefully took out the stew pot from the stove hole, scooped the stewed chicken soup into a large earthenware bowl, put the stew pot back into the stove hole, and then took several dishes to the hall and placed them on the square table.
Xiao Chaoyun was immediately attracted by the aroma of chicken soup.
The aroma was so stimulating that she couldn't resist it. It was extremely difficult to take her eyes away from the tile bowl, much harder than not looking at the sesame cakes!
Li Huiniang first helped Liang Xinming fill a large bowl of chicken soup, and gave him the chicken liver and the unseen egg yolk in the chicken belly. She also gave him one chicken leg; the remaining chicken leg was given to Xiao Chaoyun; she herself gnawed on the chicken bones and chicken feet.
